Social but not a party hostel

Welcome to Paradise, Fellow Wanderers! 🏝️

A short walk from Thong Sala Pier, Night Market, Phangan Food Court, Art Market, and the beach - Kiko’s Hostel is the perfect base to explore the island, no scooter needed.

Comfort. Cleanliness. Community.

Ready for good vibes and new friendships?

Why Choose Kiko’s?

🌊 Perfect Location

Walk to the pier, markets, and the beach. The island at your doorstep.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Social, Not a Party Hostel

Friendly, welcoming atmosphere to meet travelers — quiet after hours for great sleep.

🛏️ Modern Comfort

Newly decorated dorms with privacy curtains, reading lights, key card access, and A/C.

☕ Easy Essentials

Indoor lounge with Smart TV, outdoor terrace, and a communal kitchenette (microwave, big fridge, hot/cold water) plus free tea and coffee all day.

Meet Our Legend: Edgar!

From volunteer to the coolest manager in Southeast Asia

"5 years ago, I arrived as a wide-eyed volunteer from Izmir. Now I'm living my dream managing this incredible community. Every day brings new faces, new stories, and new adventures. That's the Kikos magic!" - Edgar
